div.div:
EventBridge Routing Rules (One Per Mission Type | ASM-161)
1. Rule: rule-inf-confirmation
• Pattern: mission_type = confirmation
• Target: SQS Confirmation Queue (retry 2x, target DLQ)
2. Rule: rule-inf-verification
• Pattern: mission_type = verification
• Target: SQS Verification Queue (retry 2x, target DLQ)
3. Rule: rule-inf-estimation
• Pattern: mission_type = estimation
• Target: SQS Estimation Queue (retry 2x, target DLQ)

div.div:
TRIGGER 4: TELEMETRY BATCH INGESTION (ADR-003, Section 3 | D09)
Field IoT Nodes (200 Pilot Farms x 2 Nodes | ASM-070)
• Soil & drying sensors; encrypted 24h buffer during outages (ASM-074)
• MQTT over mTLS 1.2+ with per-node X.509 client certificate
AWS IoT Core Regional Ingestion Endpoint (us-east-1 | D09)
• Topic: aroma/telemetry/v1/farms/{farm_id}/nodes/{node_id}/readings
• Zero private cloud IPs consumed (identity-based ingestion | ASM-032)
• Peak harvest load: 3,600 readings/day (scales to 18,000/day at 1,000 farms)
Dual Parallel Topic Rule Actions (PD-112)
• Action 1 (DynamoDB PutItem):
- Direct write of reading to DynamoDB telemetry table
- Primary key: node_id (PK), reading_timestamp (SK) | KMS: telemetry
• Action 2 (SQS SendMessage):
- Forwards reading key and payload to SQS Threshold Queue
- Decoupled ingestion; function reads stored reading with strongly
consistent GetItem from DynamoDB
• Error Action (SQS SendMessage):
- If Action 1 or 2 fails, payload routed to -pdn-sqs-ioterror
- Monitored by Alarm: -pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore

1. CONFIRMATION SQS QUEUE
Queue: -pdn-sqs-infconfirm
• Batch size: 1 message (1 mission)
• Visibility timeout: 1,800 s (6x 300 s Lambda timeout)
• KMS Key: records (ASM-097)
• Backoff: 60 s, 120 s, 240 s, 480 s | maxReceiveCount: 5
Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ):
Queue: -pdn-sqs-infconfirmdlq
• Retention: 14 days (maximum SQS window)
• KMS Key: records
• Alarm: -pdn-alarm-infconfirmdlq (depth > 0)

div.div:
4. TELEMETRY THRESHOLD QUEUE (D10 / B10)
Queue: -pdn-sqs-infthreshold
• Batch size: 10 readings (batch) | Window: 0 s
• Partial batch failures: ReportBatchItemFailures
• Visibility timeout: 360 s (6x 60 s Lambda timeout)
• KMS Key: records
• Backoff: 10 s, 20 s, 40 s, 80 s
(transient retries stay within 5-min alert budget)
• maxReceiveCount: 5 attempts
Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ):
Queue: -pdn-sqs-infthresholddlq
• Retention: 14 days | KMS Key: records
• Alarm: -pdn-alarm-infthresholddlq (depth > 0)

div.div:
OPERATOR REDRIVE & UPSTREAM DLQS
• Manual SQS DLQ Redrive: Platform operator redrives
messages to source queue after root cause resolution.
• Safe Replay: Functions are 100% idempotent (Section 6.3);
duplicate redrive finds existing result and exits cleanly
without re-invoking Bedrock model.
• Upstream Delivery DLQs:
- EventBridge Pipe DLQ: captures stream delivery drops
- EventBridge Rule Target DLQs: captures target drops
- IoT Rule Error Queue: captures failed telemetry writes
- Monitored by Alarm: -pdn-alarm-infroutedlq
• 14-Day Retention: Alarms fire on FIRST message visible.

div.div:
COMMON 7-STEP FUNCTION CONTRACT (Section 4.1):
1. Receive: Read SQS event (identifiers only; zero personal data)
2. Idempotency Check: Query result by key; if exists, delete message & stop
3. Guard Check: Verify case/order/mission state; if invalid, record guard_skipped
4. Read Input: S3 GetObject (exact SHA-256) / DynamoDB; verify person_screen = clear
5. Invoke Bedrock: Call Converse API on Nova Pro (us-east-1) with JSON schema
6. Persist: TransactWriteItems: write result record + conditional state transition
7. Finish: Delete SQS message, emit CloudWatch metrics, log structured JSON audit

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 479px; height: 1px; padding-top: 378px; margin-left: 1106px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0f172a;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#0f172a, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
FUNCTION 1: OUTBREAK CONFIRMATION (inf-confirmation | Section 4.2)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5 (bounds spend)
• Guard: Case in confirming; mission is confirmation with record_persisted
• Reads: S3 photos/ by version & SHA-256 with person_screen = clear (KMS objects)
• Model Input: Up to 8 focus photos (ASM-168) and alert environment context
• Model Output: pest_signs_present (bool), signs, person_detected, confidence [0, 1]
• Decision: focus_confirmed if pest_signs_present = true & confidence >= 0.70 (ASM-163);
else focus_not_confirmed. If no image usable -> outcome not_evaluable
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes confirmation_result to pest case;
transitions confirming -> confirmed or confirming -> not_confirmed
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER authorizes or creates a fumigation order! Authorizer
is strictly human agronomist with MFA only (A09 Section 4.3).

div.div:
FUNCTION 2: FUMIGATION VERIFICATION (inf-verification | Section 4.3)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5
• Guard: Case in verifying; fumigation order in executed; mission is verification
• Reads: S3 photos/ (up to 8 short-pass frames, person_screen = clear) & track/
geometry (track verified locally in Lambda; track NOT sent to Bedrock)
• Model Input: Up to 8 frames, confirmation result of the case for comparison
• Model Output: active_signs_at_focus (bool), person_detected, confidence [0, 1]
• Decision: can_close if pass covered focus, active_signs = false, confidence >= 0.70;
else cannot_close. If no usable image -> not_evaluable
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes verification_results;
transitions verifying -> closed or verifying -> verification_not_closable
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER closes case without persisted verification object!

div.div:
FUNCTION 3: HARVEST ESTIMATION (inf-estimation | Section 4.4)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5
• Guard: Farm has active polygon version; mission is estimation with record_persisted
• Reads: S3 photos/ (up to 20 plot photos) & maps/ (1 plot map) (person_screen = clear)
• Model Input: Up to 20 photos and 1 plot map (ASM-168) with evaluation prompt
• Model Output: Per plot: productive_cover_fraction [0, 1], crop_load_class
• Decision: Formula: estimated_sacks = area_ha x cover x yield_factor(load_class)
Farm estimate is sum over plots with low/high bounds (ASM-166)
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes harvest_estimate record in
estimates table; updates Collection Center expected-sacks view
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER creates packing orders, sacks, or code batches!

div.div:
FUNCTION 4: TELEMETRY THRESHOLD (inf-threshold | Section 4.5 | D10 / B10)
• Config: Memory 256 MB | Timeout 60 s | Concurrency 10 | Batch size 10
• Reads: Strongly consistent GetItem on DynamoDB telemetry table by key
(retried 3x if not present: 200, 400, 800 ms; then backoff to queue).
Queries active threshold version from thresholds table (zero cache). KMS telemetry.
• Rules Engine (Federation Rules): Evaluated first against dynamic ranges
(T-01..T-10) with confidence 1.0 (confidence_basis = rule). Evaluation item
written conditional on attribute_not_exists.
• Notification Dispatch (< 5-min SLA Budget): Alert event published to Amazon
SNS Alert Topic immediately on episode opening, reminder, closure, or resolution.
Notification dispatch proceeds immediately without waiting for Bedrock.
• Bedrock Plausibility Check (ASM-167): ONLY invoked for a reading opening
an episode, and ONLY AFTER alert published to SNS! Bedrock Nova Pro checks
reading against 24h context. Plausibility written onto existing evaluation item.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: Bedrock NEVER suppresses, delays, or alters an alert!
If model fails, plausibility = unavailable (batch succeeds). Zero write on telemetry.

div.div:
AMAZON BEDROCK RUNTIME (us-east-1 | ASM-160)
• Model: Amazon Nova Pro (amazon.nova-pro-v1:0)
In-Region vision-capable foundation model in us-east-1
• Mode: On-demand per request via Converse API
• Zero Persistent Compute: Zero training, zero fine-tuning,
no provisioned throughput, no SageMaker endpoints (Part E)
• Prompts: Versioned zero-shot system prompts in config;
structured JSON schema; confidence in [0, 1]
• Guardrails (PD-013): bedrock:InvokeModel permitted ONLY on
foundation-model/amazon.nova-pro-v1:0;
explicit DENY on cross-Region profiles (inference-profile/*)
• Zero Model Training: Terms guarantee data never trains base FMs

div.div:
DYNAMODB TRANSACTIONAL STORES (Section 5)
Destination Tables (KMS Key: records | 5-Year Object Lock):
• cases table: confirmation_result, verification_results
• estimates table: harvest_estimate for farm & campaign
• alerts table (Alert Store): evaluation_item, episode
• telemetry table: strongly consistent read for batch readings
Standardized Result Record Schema:
• result_id: Idempotency key ({function}#{mission_id} or reading key)
• function, outcome, result_at (UTC timestamp)
• confidence [0, 1], confidence_basis (model | rule)
• source: S3 bucket, key, version, SHA-256 or DynamoDB key
• excluded_objects: Key, version, exclusion reason
• model_id, model_region, prompt_version, bedrock_request_id
• input_tokens, output_tokens, event_id (trigger identifier)
Atomicity: TransactWriteItems writes result conditional on
attribute_not_exists(result_id) AND case/order state guard.

div.div:
S3 OBJECT STORAGE & PRIVACY (Sections 2, 10)
S3 Drone Bucket Prefixes (KMS Customer Key: objects):
• photos/, track/, maps/ (5-year Object Lock retention)
• Versioning enabled; SHA-256 verified; NO PutObject/DeleteObject
for functions: the source object remains permanent!
Person Privacy Controls (Section 10):
If an object contains a person, it is never sent to inference,
and file handling is documented and audited.
1. Detection Before Upload: Ground station on-device detector
screens photos before upload (ASM-164); person_screen flag.
2. Platform Fail-Closed: Only clear objects sent to Bedrock.
3. S3 Restricted Storage (ASM-165): Reception function moves
person_present objects to:
restricted/person/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{original_key}
Encrypted with dedicated KMS customer key: restricted (8th key).
Explicit DENY on restricted/* for all inference roles.
4. Cloud Backstop: If Bedrock returns person_detected = true,
result is discarded (outcome = not_evaluable), object moved to
restricted/, and ModelPersonDetected alarm fires.

div.div:
ERROR OBSERVATION ARCHITECTURE (Section 7)
State Invariance & Reliability Contract:
If invocation fails, the source object remains permanent and
the case state does not change. The design defines retries,
dead-letter queues, and centralized error observation.
Observation Principles:
• Dual Observation Locus: The observation point is the
function DLQ TOGETHER WITH missions reaching
record_persisted without a result (catches upstream drops).
• Immediate Alarm on First Failure: Alarms trigger on
ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible > 0 (14-day limit).
• Decoupled Operational Surface: Feeds A21 dashboard.
• Structured JSON Logging: CloudWatch Logs under KMS logs;
records event_id, outcome, result_id, model ID, error class
(zero personal data, zero image payloads).

div.div:
PROPOSED CLOUDWATCH ALARMS FOR A21 (PC-IAC-003)
1. Dead-Letter Queue Depth (MessagesVisible > 0):
• -pdn-alarm-infconfirmdlq (Confirmation DLQ depth > 0)
• -pdn-alarm-infverifydlq (Verification DLQ depth > 0)
• -pdn-alarm-infestimatedlq (Estimation DLQ depth > 0)
• -pdn-alarm-infthresholddlq (Threshold DLQ depth > 0)
2. Upstream Event Ingestion & Routing Drop:
• -pdn-alarm-infroutedlq
Monitors EventBridge Pipe DLQ, Rule Target DLQs,
and FailedInvocations metric.
3. Oldest Message Age (Queue Processing Lag):
• -pdn-alarm-inf{confirm,verify,estimate,threshold}age
Monitors ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage on primary queues.
4. Invocations Failed Without State Change (State Invariance):
• -pdn-alarm-inffailed
Custom metric: InferenceFailed in AromaPacifico/Inference.
5. Missions Awaiting Result (Pipeline Disconnect):
• -pdn-alarm-infawaiting
Custom metric: MissionsAwaitingResult (> timeout threshold).
6. Reading Not Persisted Before Evaluation:
• -pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore
Custom metric: ReadingNotPersisted & IoT error queue depth.
7. Bedrock Model Throttling & Quotas:
• -pdn-alarm-infthrottle
Monitors AWS/Bedrock throttles & metric InferenceThrottled.
8. Person Detected in Crop Object (Privacy Incident):
• -pdn-alarm-infperson
Custom metric: ModelPersonDetected > 0 (operator incident).

div.div:
Legal & Compliance Safeguards:
• Transfer of Colombian agricultural data to USA is submitted to the Federation under Question Q-02 and PD-101.
• Personal Data Isolation: Stored in personal-data table encrypted with KMS personal; no inference function role holds this key.
• Bedrock Terms: Amazon Bedrock does not use customer prompts or completions to train base foundation models.

div.div:
Idempotency Mechanics (Section 6.3):
• Drone Functions: result_id = {function}#{mission_id}. Conditional put prevents duplicate result; transaction verifies source state.
• Telemetry Function: result_id = {node_id}#{variable}#{reading_timestamp}. Conditional put prevents duplicate episode opening.
• SQS Dead-Letter Redrive: Safe to redrive at any time; duplicate event finds existing result and deletes itself without calling model.

div.div:
Track B / IaC Box Traceability (docs/architecture.md Section 14)
• D10 (#30 / B10): Event-Driven Inference Function Pattern
Coded pattern of Epic 6: SQS threshold queue, Lambda rules engine, Alert Store, SNS topic, Bedrock plausibility check, DLQs.
• D09 (#29 / B09): Telemetry Ingestion Pattern Module (ADR-003)
AWS IoT Core, topic rules, DynamoDB telemetry table, IoT rule error SQS queue.
• D06 (#26 / B06): Identities & KMS Customer Keys
IAM Lambda execution roles (least privilege), KMS keys: records, telemetry, objects, logs, restricted.
(Note: D04 is omitted because inference functions are not VPC-attached)

div.div:
Harvest Volume & Spend Drivers (Section 9 | ASM-168, ASM-169)
• Telemetry: 108,000 readings/harvest month (200 farms x 6/day + 100 farms x 24/day); Bedrock called ONLY on episode openings.
• Confirmation: ~1/alert; up to 8 focus photos.
• Verification: ~1/fumigation; up to 8 short-pass frames.
• Estimation: 200 flights/campaign (1/farm/harvest campaign); up to 20 plot photos + 1 plot map.
• Cost Controls: On-demand Bedrock (zero idle compute), idempotency avoids re-invocation, image caps enforce predictable token budgets.

• ASM-162 (Failure parameters & backoff) • ASM-163 (0.70 confidence threshold)
• ASM-164 (On-device person detector) • ASM-165 (Restricted prefix & key)
• ASM-166 (Estimation formula & factors) • ASM-167 (Telemetry plausibility on openings)
• ASM-168 (Image caps per invocation) • ASM-169 (Named pricing parameters for A23)
• PD-013 (Closed: Region & Colombia exit) • PD-014 (Closed: Retries, DLQ & observation)
• PD-015 (Closed: Person object handling) • PD-111 (Closed: Persisted object trigger)
• PD-112 (Closed: Telemetry store coupling) • PD-135 (Closed: A14 evaluation contract)
• PD-161 (Closed: B10 telemetry pattern) • PD-018 (Open: AWS live feature re-check)
